purpose: Zoom the current view along the declared Ctrl+middle-drag path using calibrated navigation input.
trigger: Use when the viewport is unobstructed, no geometry tool is active, and Ctrl+middle-drag or Zoom is calibrated.

inputs.name: viewport
inputs.description: Maximized unobstructed viewport and empty drag region.

inputs.name: drag_path
inputs.description: One short zoom drag path and declared direction.

inputs.name: navigation_mapping
inputs.description: Verified Ctrl+middle-drag Zoom mapping or Zoom-tool equivalent.

preconditions: Viewport is unobstructed and no geometry tool is active.
Ctrl+middle-drag is exposed/calibrated or the visible Zoom tool can provide a left-drag equivalent.

outputs.name: zoomed_view
outputs.description: Before/after apparent scale, camera orientation, drag/control path, and geometry-unchanged observation.

postconditions: The displayed scale changes in the declared direction while model geometry, dimensions, and orientation remain unchanged.
If Ctrl+middle-drag is unsupported, direct Ctrl+middle-drag is not claimed.

implementation.target_environment: Authorized SpaceClaim V21 desktop session with the window maximized/full-screen unless a recorded layout exception applies.
implementation.notes: The controller performs one bounded GUI observation/action; it must calibrate the current mapping and must not expand this atom into a view workflow. Direct Ctrl+middle-button automation is capability-gated; Zoom-tool equivalent is explicit.

ambiguity_checks: Resolve the declared target from its supplied identity and semantic properties; do not use arbitrary BodyN/FaceN aliases or return order.
If the target is not unique or the current topology/view cannot be observed, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; this operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.condition: The declared target, scope, or view identity is missing or ambiguous.
failure_modes.detection: The supplied identity does not resolve to exactly one current target.
failure_modes.safe_state: No validation action is performed and no pass claim is emitted.

failure_modes.condition: The required API, host path, controller gesture, or visible state cannot be observed.
failure_modes.detection: The adapter or controller reports unsupported/blocked/unknown state.
failure_modes.safe_state: Preserve the current document/view and return needs_manual_review or not_tested.

recovery.action: Strengthen the target identity or stop for manual review; do not substitute a numbered alias.
Use only a verified equivalent control/API or return needs_manual_review; do not repeat an unsupported gesture.
